description: Human-scored scenarios for affected-test-first selection and honest coverage reporting.

scenarios.prompt: Use b-test for a change touching parser.py and its Parser class. A current CodeGraph index is available. Select affected tests first, run that narrow set, and report what remains uncovered instead of claiming full-suite coverage.
must: Ask CodeGraph for changed-symbol or file impact and affected tests
Run the affected narrow set before the broad suite
avoid: Claiming full-suite coverage from an affected-only run

scenarios.prompt: Use b-test when CodeGraph is unavailable for a change in parser.py. Use local search and repository test discovery as the fallback, run the narrow set first, and disclose the limitation.
must: Use local search or repository test discovery as fallback
Run the narrow affected set first
Disclose that CodeGraph was unavailable and any remaining gap
avoid: Claiming full-suite coverage from a partial run
